description: Main.java source file for the MkStubs application, which processes JAR files to generate stubs and source code, including command-line argument parsing, filtering, and stub generation.

classes.name: Main
classes.description: Main class of the MkStubs application, handling argument processing, filtering, and stub generation.

classes.name: Params
classes.description: Holds command-line parameters such as input/output paths, filter, verbose and dump source flags.

classes.name: Logger
classes.description: Handles conditional logging based on verbose flag.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Entry point that processes command-line arguments and runs the main workflow.

methods.name: processArgs
methods.description: Parses command-line arguments into Params object.

methods.name: addString
methods.description: Adds pattern strings to the filter based on syntax (+, -, @).

methods.name: addStringsFromFile
methods.description: Reads patterns from a file and adds them to the filter.

methods.name: process
methods.description: Main workflow: reads input JAR, filters classes, optionally generates source, and creates stub JAR.
